title: Christophe NDE 5116
content: December 1, 2009, 19:00, It is night time. I am driving alone, the road is straight, and I am not driving very fast. An object falls from the passenger seat, I unfasten my seat belt and I bend to retrieve it. I lose control of the car. I have no memory from the moment when I bent to retrieve that object until the morning after - and even so, painkillers have erased my memory a lot. I was ejected five meters away from the car. I had a broken pelvis (three times), broken neck vertebra (C1), broken ribs, spleen outpouring, various pelvic bruises and brain trauma. I was in critical condition from midnight to 6:00 am. (I can't be sure about when I had the experience. However, I believe it occurred when I had the accident.) All is cold and black. Without exaggeration, the atmosphere seemed as if there was nothing on earth anymore. No ground, no sky, no skyline, just black. I feel I am lying on some surface, though. I see a white light in the distance, like a lobby entrance or an opened door. The light is coming closer, or, rather, I feel I am going toward the light - as if I were walking but without walking, I feel my body does not move. It is very hard to describe. Once I arrive close to the light, a being on my right stops me. Without recognizing him by his appearance, I know who he is - he is my Grandfather. He tells me something like, 'No, not now, go back.' (I know these are short sentences. I think he said more, but I am unable to recall the exact words.) I can also tell that he is calm and kind, but, at the same time, I feel he is deeply angry with me. Then I see the light going away. That's it. It's not much, but the more I think about it, the odder I feel. I did not share it with anybody because I felt it was just for me; and, besides, I thought nobody would really believe me anyway. Today I'm convinced that my grandfather (and it absolutely was my grandfather) knew that I mustn't go into the light. I even believe I remember he told me something like I wasn't finished with something??? I believe I am here today (maybe) to do something, but I don't know what it is. I only know it's important. I am much more sensitive, emotional today than I was prior to the experience. Thank you for reading.

environment.environment_other_detail: Cold, black void-like setting: 'No ground, no sky, no skyline, just black.' White light in the distance 'like a lobby entrance or an opened door.'

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Grandfather stopped him and said, "No, not now, go back," and experiencer believes he was 'not finished with something' / had something important to do.
boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Experiencer believes he is here 'to do something' and that 'it's important,' but does not know what.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Cold black void; movement toward a distant white light 'like a lobby entrance or an opened door'; stopped by deceased grandfather who said to go back; light receded.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No OBE/tunnel described; begins in blackness, sees light, approaches it, is stopped by grandfather, then returns as light goes away.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The environment is described as an empty, cold blackness with a distant white light resembling 'a lobby entrance or an opened door,' and the return occurs as 'the light going away' after being verbally stopped by his grandfather.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "No ground, no sky, no skyline, just black." / "I see a white light in the distance, like a lobby entrance or an opened door." / "No, not now, go back."
